method: Visual spot-check of four deterministic random samples per downloaded TARI/TOM folder; not clinical relabelling. Seed 42.
tari: Reviewed examples are close-up maize leaves. Lethal-necrosis examples share a green background, while other displayed classes often have a light background: possible class/background confounding, requiring cross-source validation.
tom2024: Reviewed images are cropped leaf fragments with variable resolution. Some are smaller than the application minimum. Generic class names do not establish a specific pathogen.
limitation: Only a small preview was inspected manually. No claim that every label is correct.
